'''Blasted Asteroid''' was a commercial chain of [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] that operated after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the war, cantinas in the chain could be found in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One such [[Blasted Asteroid (the Wheel)|cantina]] was built on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] space station and employed [[Ceoloe]], a muscular [[Human/Legends|Human]], as both a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]].<ref name="BTR" /> Another [[Blasted Asteroid (Trivar II)|cantina]] in the franchise was built in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Glare Peak]] on the planet [[Trivar II/Legends|Trivar II]], although the building was partially destroyed when a Rebel [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] crashed into it.<ref name="RaGP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blasted Asteroid cantina chain was first introduced in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'', and released in [[2013]]. The cantina on the Wheel was one location players could potentially visit while searching for information during the first episode of the game.<ref name="BTR" />
